description:
## What

Add a new Notice variant to pkix-lint::Severity, slotted between Info and Warn:

```rust
#[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum Severity {
    /// Advisory / best-practice -- does not constitute a violation.
    Info,
    /// Minor observation (zlint-style notice) -- not a violation but worth surfacing.
    ///
    /// Aligns with syslog severity 5 (Notice) and zlint catalog 'notice' verdict.
    Notice,
    /// Violation of a SHOULD or RECOMMENDED requirement.
    Warn,
    /// Violation of a MUST or REQUIRED requirement.
    Error,
    /// Violation so severe that further evaluation is meaningless.
    Fatal,
}
```

## Why

PKIX-jy95.2 decided to preserve zlint's notice-level vocabulary as a distinct workspace severity. Notice slots between Info and Warn matching both zlint (where Notice(4) sits between Pass(3) and Warn(5)) and syslog RFC 5424 (where Informational > Notice > Warning by severity ranking).

## Implementation

- pkix-lint/src/lib.rs line ~238: insert Notice as second enum variant
- Verify no exhaustive match clauses in pkix-lint or pkix-lint-cabf break (the non_exhaustive marker means callers MUST already include a wildcard, but in-tree code might match exhaustively for clarity -- if so, add Notice arms)
- Update Severity rustdoc to mention syslog + zlint alignment
- Run cargo test pkix-lint pkix-lint-cabf
- CHANGELOG entry: 'Severity: add Notice variant between Info and Warn (zlint + syslog alignment).'
- Bumps pkix-lint to a new minor version per semver (adding a variant to a non_exhaustive enum is non-breaking)

## Acceptance

- [ ] pkix-lint Severity has Notice variant
- [ ] Severity PartialOrd derives the correct ordering (verified by test: `Severity::Info < Severity::Notice < Severity::Warn`)
- [ ] All existing pkix-lint + pkix-lint-cabf tests pass
- [ ] No exhaustive matches on Severity in workspace code break
- [ ] CHANGELOG + minor version bump

## Out of scope

- Mapping zlint severities into Notice (that happens in pkix-zlint-bridge per PKIX-jy95.7)
- Renaming Info or merging Info/Notice (decision was to keep both)

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jy95.2 (decision that filed this task)
- PKIX-jy95.7 (pkix-zlint-bridge -- will emit Notice for zlint notice-level findings)

title: Extend pkix-lint::Severity enum with Notice variant (between Info and Warn)
